result.edit: Fix the case selectors: the literals were written as 2-bit hex (2'h00, 2'h01, 2'h10, 2'h11), and 2'h10/2'h11 truncate to 2'b00/2'b01 for a 2-bit selector, so sel=10 and sel=11 wrongly re-selected a and b (the duplicate branches never reached c and d). Change the case item literals to true 2-bit binary (2'b00, 2'b01, 2'b10, 2'b11) so sel selects a, b, c, d respectively, while keeping the interface, comments and the combinational always block unchanged.
